description: Textxt lets users connect their Textxt account to ChatGPT so they can search, summarize, and retrieve their own readable Textxt chats in conversation. The connector is read-only: it can list recent chats, search messages, fetch context for a search result, and read recent messages from a selected chat/topic. It does not send, edit, delete, or publish messages.

defaultPrompt: Use Textxt to list my recent chats.
